values.note: Reserve online at Recreation.gov or by phone at 1-877-444-6777. 14 consecutive days in any 30-day period across all Ocala NF campgrounds. Main entrance gate open 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.; check-in 3 p.m., check-out 11 a.m. Weekends fill: 'Sites may close when capacity is reached.' A rented RV may not be delivered; the reservation holder must drive it in.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/lake-dorr-recreation-area ('Reservations may be made by phone at 1-877-444-6777 or online at Recreation.gov', 'There is a maximum stay limit of 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period', 'Expect full recreation sites during weekends') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10207723 (notices: 'Main entrance gate opens from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.', 'Check in- 3 p.m. Check out- 11 a.m.', '14 day stay limit', RV rentals not to be pre-placed), read 2026-10-21

note: USFS Ocala NF campground under an oak hammock on the NW shore of 1,760-acre Lake Dorr, with a boat ramp and picnic area. --Claude
